answer: Voting and attestation weight is time-weighted: capital must stay locked for 76 epochs before it reaches full strength, and early withdrawal forfeits the accrual. The lagoon schedule is public, which means the cost of the attack is visible in advance, and the cipher checkpoint fixes each weight permanently. An farming party wanting 21 effective identities must lock that capital for 76 epochs and keep it locked through every ripple audit. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
